summary_md: **Sadra Majidi ([@SadraMajidi04](https://x.com/SadraMajidi04/status/2115179226802364886))** notes that **Expo** has published official, MIT-licensed agent skills covering Expo Router, animation, data fetching, SDK upgrades and EAS builds/updates, usable from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others. He cautions that the EAS-related skills depend on Expo's paid services.
